combo_label: Fruit & Veg × At the Art Gallery × Dinosaurs

entries.clue: Colossal ancient shark known mainly from teeth the size of your hand
Glossy purple teardrop at the heart of moussaka and baba ganoush
Crumbly mud-rock whose papery layers hold prints of long-vanished life
Orchard staple that reputedly keeps the doctor away
Guided loop past the highlights, headset optional
Little label beside the work giving artist, title, year
Hardy round winter root that made the original Halloween lantern
Perfectly ready to eat, like a pear yielding at the thumb
Sky-fall calamity of sixty-six million years ago; the great reptiles never recovered
Surrealist who let the watches melt and the whiskers curl
Coiled ram's-horn seashell that tumbles from crumbling seaside cliffs
Commissioned likeness of a single flattered face
